parameters.description:
`zoom-relay` accepts an HTTP POST with a native `zoom` payload. The gateway composes the upstream Zoom URL from your stored secrets, injects your `Authorization` credential header, and forwards the request, so your credentials never leave the platform.

Two channels are available: the free `byok` channel uses your own stored credentials; the `plus` channel binds an extra per-enrollment credential via enrollment parameters (the `api_key_secret` parameter names the customer secret holding it).
parameters.summary: Relay a message to your own Zoom Team Chat through the UnitySVC gateway by posting a native Zoom payload.

api_key_secret.description: Name of the customer secret holding this enrollment's API credential
